activations.title: Activations
activations.hint: Activating a variant makes it the reference model for the company. It starts as “proposed”: real activation is a second, deliberate step.
activations.error: The activation could not be created.
activations.statusError: The status could not be changed.
activations.loadError: The activations could not be loaded.
activations.caption: Activations recorded for this company.

dossier.title: Configuration dossiers
dossier.description: The document describing how a company is configured: identity, industry model and process decisions.
dossier.name: Name
dossier.emptyDescription: No configuration dossier has been composed yet.
dossier.error: The dossiers could not be loaded.
dossier.caption: List of configuration dossiers
dossier.createHint: A dossier may exist before the company: during a negotiation the company is left empty.

identity.incomplete: Fill in activity and size band to receive a model proposal.

proposal.title: Proposed model
proposal.noFallback: No similar model is proposed: it would be a false answer.

decisions.rationaleRequired: A decision without a rationale is not a decision.
decisions.cleared: The decision was removed: the model applies.
decisions.empty: No model pinned yet: there is nothing to decide on.
decisions.preparedByAgent: Prepared by the assistant: check and record it, or change it.
decisions.agentPending: Decisions prepared by the assistant and not yet recorded: {{n}}

submit.done: Version submitted: an approval request was opened.

build.title: Company build
build.description: The plan of what would be created, and the signature that creates it. Two distinct steps, and neither builds on its own.
build.planIsReadOnly: Asking for the plan writes nothing: it is a read, and the numbers below are a forecast.
build.planError: The plan cannot be computed for this version.
build.alreadyThereMeans: "Already there" is what tells a fresh build apart from a re-apply onto an already populated company.
build.applyOpensApproval: Applying does NOT build: it opens an approval request. The build happens when that request is approved.
build.noCountsYet: No row counts, and that is not an omission: nothing has been built yet.
build.blockedNoPermission: Write permission on dossiers is required.
build.blockedApplied: This version has already been applied.
build.blockedNotApproved: The version is in state {{status}}: only an approved version can be applied.
build.registryHint: After the build, every row created by this version is listed in the registry, with its table and rationale.
build.blockedNoPlan: The plan cannot be computed: there is nothing to sign until the model has content.

gestione.confermaTogli: Remove this activation proposal? It never started: it is deleted.
gestione.processoSconosciuto: Process no longer in the model
gestione.confermaTogliScostamento: Remove the deviation? The process goes back to what the model says.

gestioneFascicolo.confermaArchivia: Archive the dossier? It can be reactivated.
gestioneFascicolo.confermaCollega: Link the dossier to this company? A company has one active dossier.
gestioneFascicolo.ricercaSpiega: The agent looks for sources and proposals for a domain; proposals are approved on the runs page, then applied to the model here.
gestioneFascicolo.ricercaDettaglio: The agent reads the pages and checks every proposal; at the end you will see here how many passed.
gestioneFascicolo.confermaRicerca: Start research for this domain? It can take a few minutes.
gestioneFascicolo.applicazioneDettaglio: Approved proposals go into the version's model and sources into the register.
gestioneFascicolo.confermaApplica: Apply the approved proposals to this version's model?

proposteCorsa.motivazioneMinima: At least {{n}} characters: why you decide so

famiglie.hint: A family groups the variants of an operating model (for example by company size). A family or a variant is not removed: its name or description is corrected.
famiglie.errore: The change was not saved. Check that the code does not already exist and try again.

varianti.errore: The variant was not saved. Check that the code does not already exist and try again.

processi.errore: The process was not updated. Try again.

processiDelTenant.title: Processes
processiDelTenant.description: The company's processes, each with its subprocesses, activities, who performs them and the units that take part.
processiDelTenant.emptyDescription: The company has no active processes yet.
processiDelTenant.caption: Company processes by name

scheda.error: Unable to load the process card.
scheda.senzaScopo: The purpose of the process is not described.
scheda.chiFaCosaNota: For each unit, the activities it performs in this process.
scheda.nessunaUnita: No unit takes part in the process.
scheda.nessunKpi: The model process declares no indicators.
scheda.nessunaCompetenza: The performing positions declare no skills.
scheda.nessunProgetto: No project is linked to the process.
scheda.flussoNota: One lane per unit; activities read left to right and subprocesses are the bands at the top. Double-click an activity to open it, a unit for its card.
scheda.grafoNota: The process, its subprocesses, the activities and the units that perform them. Double-click a subprocess to open it, an activity for details, a unit for its card.

matrice.spiega: R = responsible (filled), E = executing (grey), C = consulted (dashed), I = informed (light). The E/C column counts executing and consulted units. Hover a column header for the unit's full name; click a process code to open its sheet.
matrice.errore: Could not load the process matrix.
matrice.vuota: No process has participating units yet: the matrix has nothing to show.
